nom: The Ordinary Squalane Cleanser Hydrating Makeup Remover

avis.titre: Product is fine but not worth of the money
avis.texte: It does remove your makeup and is not harsh. I use it in the shower so I can wash any remaining makeup off. However, I do not think it is a good value. The container is only half full. I know it's inexpensive, but it should be filled more. Other drugstore priced products have more in their container.

avis.titre: Been buying for a few years now
avis.texte: Great for gentle cleansing and works on my waterproof mascara.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again
avis.texte: I was introduced to this product by my daughter and I've gotten so many compliments on my skin ever since I've started using it.

I've been using this face wash daily for years now. Fully cleans my dry sensitive skin without any reactions, much better than any others I've tried. Very gentle. A simple routine has always worked better for my skin than a ton of steps and getting irritation. Just wish Ulta sold the larger size in person so I could save on shipping, but I order multiple bottles once a year to make it worth it. Lasts a longer time too

This balm type cleanser is great. A little bit goes a long way. Leaves my face feeling smooth and clean after removal. I have dry skin and this product feels like a good fit and my skin seems to like it.

avis.titre: Yes, and I have purchased every time I run out.
avis.texte: Love it, use morning and night routine, your skin is clean and moisturied.
I am so thankful to have finally found a cleanser that removes ALL my longwearing and even waterproof makeup! I was so sick of double cleansing and having to use a separate eye makeup remover.

avis.titre: Nice, but not fond of smell
avis.texte: I like this cleanser but im not fond of the smell. It smells bland, no pleasant aroma for something you are applying to your face. It does cleanse very good on the face.
This product has made my skin feel smooth after one day of using it. I have also noticed that my skin has been clearing when I use it after my shower, overall a very good product!

Even though it says makeup remover, I don't wear makeup and I love this. It dissolves all the dirt and sweat that accumulated during day. It leaves my skin clean and soft. This is a great product and the price is outstanding. On a side note this was delivered with other items that was missing their tops and everything inside was wet. I was able to just wipe it off, so not that big of a deal.
This cleanser feels so good when applying to your skin, and works exceptionally well at cleansing. Highly recommend.
I've been using this cleanser for years and I love it! I use it both for removing makeup and double cleansing. I have dry and sensitive skin and this has never irritated my skin. Highly recommend!
Great to remove sunscreen and makeup, including mascara. I follow up with a gentle light foaming cleanser as a second cleanse.

This isn't for me and my skin type. im a combo oily girl and this is more for dry skin girls. If you suffer from dry spots ESPECIALLY in the winter this is a nice cleanser. But I would ALWAYS DOUBLE CLEANSE because this alone will not get your makeup off, and face clean. It is great to keep your monster from being stripped during the cleansing process, but I found that it didnt cleanse my heavily oiled face enough. I wouldn't only recommend to VERY DRY PEOPLE.
I like how purposeful each ingredient is in this product! Works very well and has a good consistency. I also like that the squalene is vegan friendly. Gets an excellent rating on the Yuka app.
I would never have expected to like a balm cleanser, but this one is fantastic. Gets makeup off, leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.

I have sensitive mature skin. This means, I need something that is both moisturizing and gentle. This cleanser was ok. On the plus side - no fragrance, nice texture, and didn't irritate my skin. I'll try other cleansers before coming back to this.
It does remove most makeup but not all mascara so I still have to use something else. But over all its a great cleanser

Great price, effective cleanser. I have dry sensitive skin. I dont find this to hydrate but doesnt leave residue either. Takes time to take off extensive eye makeup, but is possible. Ive repurchased this 4 times.
I ended up switching to a more hydrating cleanser. This one was not suitable for my aging skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I'm so glad that I found this product. 64 year skin that feels fresh and moisturized after each wash. Definitely recommend

Left an oily residue. For comparison, I will sometimes use Lancome's Bi-facil makeup remover (think micellar) and it's less oily after use than this face wash. I broke out with several deep blemishes on my cheek and below my chin that took a while to heal. I have combination skin, so the placement surprised me. Also doesn't remove all waterproof mascara well.
This cleanser made my eyes blurry. That's with them being closed shut. It didn't even take off my makeup like it claims it would. There's better cleansers out there.

avis.titre: Change of ingredients - not so "clean" anymore
avis.texte: So disappointed in this brand. Have been buying products for years since they are known for being a "clean" brand. They have changed their formula on this face wash and it is no longer clean. I an trying to use chemically clean products so this bait and switch is very disappointing. Will be returning this product and finding another face wash.

I keep stocked on this product. It turned my acne around, after my facialist advised me to doubke cleanse, using something with squalene. I didn't realize mu makeup was actually not coming off 100% with other washes. This has a good consistency to take everything off, even my mascara so nothing is on the pillow. Cleared my skin up.

So I first started using the Squaline as added moisture when applying my foundation. Then I found the cleanser. I tried the smaller size . Loved it went back and purchased the larger size. I do use it opposite of some. I cleanse 1st with another then with the squaline cleanser because it moisturizes and does not strip my skin. I have very sensitive skin and it agrees with my skin
Did not remove mascara (regular, not waterproof mascara). Skin did not feel clean after washing.

avis.titre: This stuff is my Holy Grail
avis.texte: I dealt with acne for so long before I found this product. It cleanses to the BONE and keeps my oily, acne prone skin looking fresh✨ can't live without it
This does a good job removing my makeup, except mascara. I still need to use micellar water for that. It keeps my skin soft and feeling hydrated after use

I always keep this on hand. I tend to rotate cleansers depending on what is happenig with my skin. This is the one I always go back to when my skin is irritated and inflamed. Within a couple days everything is back to normal. Great price and my skin loves it.

I love this cleanser because I don't have to use a different product to remove mascara and other eye makeup. It does not irritate my eyes any at all. The packaging is also nice because it does not leak when I am traveling.
I love this face wash. takes care of skin/makeup. face feels clean but moisture after.
Since I love this brand, I wanted to love this product as well but dont. It didnt feel like it really cleaned my face . I felt like I had to use a lot, and the bottle went quickly
Since I love this brand, I wanted to love this product as well but dont. It didnt feel like it really cleaned my face . I felt like I had to use a lot, and the bottle went quickly

I am 56 and my skin has NEVER looked better....my daughter bought me this line for Christmas and I won't go back...honestly...I feel bad for the women who tried this and were disappointed...my new love!!! ♥️

Of all the cleansing oil and balms I've tried, this is the only one that works for my sensitive, clog and acne-prone skin. It gets off everything, washes off easily, and does not leave my skin stripped, irritated, or with any sort of film on it.

At such a cheap price point, I had some reservations about trying this product. However, the Ordinary is really solid proof that affordable and efficacious don't have to be mutually exclusive after all! I'm so impressed by this product in particular, as it has now become my absolute favorite cleanser! I highly recommend this cleanser for anybody with especially dry and/or acne-prone skin because the squalane formulation retains the moisture required to maintain a healthy skin barrier, without any harsh stripping. No other cleanser has left my face so hydrated and it has smoothed the rough texture I previously suffered from with its mattifying, pore-blurring finish.

I have mature skin and use Estée Lauder double wear. This cleanser takes my makeup off but gentle enough to use on my sensitive eyes! It doesn't dry out my skin and most importantly, doesn't break me out! Love all The Ordinary products that I've used! Very affordable, so it's a win, win on all accounts!

this face wash is awesome. very moisturizing!!! Just need a little, apply to dry skin, it's great how it turns liquidity the more you massage in. easy to use, leaves face feeling clean and soft. the Ordinary products are really good 👍

I used a dime size amount 3 times and it's already gone. I dont feel i can leave a decenr review since i barely got to try it. Im not sure why it was basically empty. I really wanted to like this too. But it feels nice and creamy im just unsure how well it works since i didnt get a long experience

This cleanser is great. Its nourishing, cleansing, and just feels so nice and smooth and doesnt give that squeaky clean feel. However, It doesnt stand out. Its not bad but I feel myself reaching for other cleansers I own rather than this.

This cleanser is great. Its nourishing, cleansing, and just feels so nice and smooth and doesnt give that squeaky clean feel. However, It doesnt stand out. Its not bad but I feel myself reaching for other cleansers I own rather than this.

This cleanser is great. Its nourishing, cleansing, and just feels so nice and smooth and doesnt give that squeaky clean feel. However, It doesnt stand out. Its not bad but I feel myself reaching for other cleansers I own rather than this.
This was the only product I changed in my routine and my skin broke out horribly!! I've never seen my skin breakout so badly and painfully as soon as I stopped using it I'm clearing right back up
I deal with combo skin that seems mostly oily. I use this to remove makeup and cleanse. I rinse it off and my skin feels so soft and moisturized! It also helps soothe my skin when it's irritated!

avis.titre: A little goes along way but
avis.texte: But it in no way removes anything. I have to use this. Clean myface again. Use it again. An will still habe tinted sunscreen an mascara on when I am out. This doesnt work.

This product does wonders for people who have dry skin. I use this product as directed with warm water and then follow with a foaming cleanser with cold water and my skin always looks gleaming and glassy after I'm finished! I've been using this for over two years and I'm a huge fan.

So, firstly, I did not do my research on Squalane. Your face naturally produces squalene to moisturize your face, but it traps oils in your pores. Squalane is a processed version of this. This product IS comedogenic. It will cause a horrible breakout, it has to me in less than a week. There's no active ingredients to actually cleanse your face. If you do use it, use a water based cleanser after to get the squalane out of your pores.
I had gotten this as a free gift at ulta, and i,m so glad I got it! is is so hydrating and is very gentle on my skin! totally recommend!

Most other oil cleansers I've tried have broken me out like crazy but this one is gentle, hydrating, and effective at removing dirt and grime. It's the first step in my double cleanse and I love it. The price is great too.
This was the only product I changed in my routine and it made me brake out more than i have in years.

Makes washing my face before bed a quick and enjoyable experience. Used for make-up removal and daily face cleaning and the texture is amazing. Unsure of why people saying there isn't enough product. I get the 5 ounce bottle and it lasts at least 2 months

avis.titre: My aging skin loves this cleanser!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser! I'm 52 with mostly oily skin and my skin hasn't been this happy and healthy looking for a long time. I start my cleansing routine by removing my makeup with a micellular water and then I follow it up by cleansing it with this. My skin is smooth and clean but it doesn't feel tight or dry and I attribute that to this cleanser. I'll never use a foaming cleanser on my face and again and I'll use this cleanser as long as they're making it.

The texture is so pleasing, it works wonders for oily skin after a long day. Takes off sunscreen and makeup like a pro. Leaves skin nice and soft and clean. It's so much fun to rub into skin and and then washes off impeccably.

avis.titre: Feels great and my skin loves it.
avis.texte: Recommended by some Philippina friends whose skin is beautiful!!! They use entire Ordinary line of products. I'm starting out with the cleanser and love the product, the way my face feels, and the cost fits in with my budget - I'm retired!

avis.titre: Can't use… but you might like it!
avis.texte: I will start with the postives: it did remove my sunscreen, make up, and oil (tzone) really well and it didnt make my vision blurry. Once you rub it on leave it for 30 seconds before washing it off. The downside is it irritated my skin. Its the second cleanser like this I've tried and they both did the same thing. My skin hurt like i had a sunburn afterwards. I am prob in the minuscule percentage of people who have a sensitivity to something in it and would have this reaction. If you are on the fence try it, yiu might love it.

I want this product to have 5 stars. Im in love and cant say enough. Gentle and through. Nourishing and not greesy. Doesnt leave any residue whatsoever. Washes off make up and daily dirt and oil. Leaves skin feeling supple and not stripped. Pores feel and look clean and reduced. Gentle on the eyes and nose. Just buy it!
Really releases the dirt and make up to really clean your skin and is not harsh and doesn't make me break out

I struggle with dry skin and tend to have trouble when using foaming cleansers as they make my skin feel tight and dry but this cleanser has been the one that has really helped make my skin feel hydrated and not stripped! A little goes a long way when you emulsify it with water. I sometimes apply to dry skin and add my exfoliant powder to it and add water to emulsify it. While it feels somewhat oily going on my dry skin, it doesnt leave my skin feeling greasy after. I have not broken out from it like other moisturizing/hydrating cleansers! Have bought this many times and will continue. I use this and then apply Thayers Toner, The 6 Peptide Skin Booster, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid and lastly their 100% Plant-Derived Squalane and my skin feels hydrated and clean!

i do like this product like im on bottle #3 now but tell me why its bleaching my towels????? like hello? i tested it out and its fr bleachinf them 😭😭 perfect for taking off my makeup, i will be buying again but y is it bleaching my towels yall
It is a gel- like substance. It is very lightweight which is great for me because I have combo acne prone skin.

I wanted to love this cleanser because I like The Ordinary products but sadly this doesnt feel effective in the slightest as a cleanser let alone a makeup cleanser. it does nothing for (not even waterproof) makeup even after a double wash. have used it MANY times in hopes it would help but never does. all in all it is not worth it.

avis.titre: Made a difference in my skin care.
avis.texte: My shin is glowing, softer, and even after using this product

Considering this is one of The Ordinary's only cleansers, this was disappointing. The product smells very chemically, and I had to use a lot. It also does not lather, which is difficult to get used to. I found that it dried my skin out terribly as well. I'm a big fan of The Ordinary's other products, so I'm hoping they'll expand their cleansers soon!

avis.titre: Smells like powdered sugar covered elephant ears at the fair
avis.texte: I purchased this one after having to return one of the other TO moisturizers. The other one had a horrible smell, like a wet dog. I tried it again a second time the next day, and I just couldn't deal. I exchanged it for this one and the smell reminds me of powdered sugar covered elephant ears from the NC state fair. Ohhhh so sweet and delicious. The smell alone boosts my mood. It's my personal moment of heaven every morning and night. A definite mood booster. Love love love.

I've been using this cleanser for a few years now and absolutely REFUSE to switch to another. And trust me, I've definitely tried other cleansers after using this one just to see if maybe I'd like them too (the other cleansers were the foam wash and cream cleanser by this same brand and they were okayyy) but THIS SPECIFIC cleanser has always and will always be my go to. I think it's perfect for combo/oily skin because it moisturizes the right areas and reduces excess oil in the right areas! 1000/10 product ❤️

avis.titre: Little bottle, little to no product
avis.texte: I just got this cleanser a few days ago and when I used it for the first time i was struggling to get any product out. It almost felt like there was no product in it at all. Very disappointing.

I take about the top of my pointer finger to the first line on my finger. This will effectively take off caked on makeup + mascara. Whether on dry or wet face. I always come back to purchasing this as it is effective and (was) affordable. It lasts me a long time. I will keep repurchasing as I haven't found anything that takes off makeup this well at this price + amount of product. I have normal-ish (sometimes combo) skin and the squalene/ingredients don't bother me at all. I have now been using it for years (with breaks inbetween trying other products).
Ill try their other one but this one doesn't give me a clean feeling.

avis.titre: I use this twice a day
avis.texte: I love this cleanser. I have combination skin with an oily Tzone. In the morning I use it alone and in the evening I use it as a first step in my double cleansing routine. I've used it now for about 3 months and I absolutely love that my skin doesn't feel dry afterwards. Rub it on your fingers together to warm it, then rub it into your skin and rinse. It's a big fat YES for me.
I know this cleanser has a 6month shelf life. It went rancid before 6 months, with a third left in the container. Just know that when ordering the larger size.

I brought this cleanser as a recommendation to buy my skin regimen with the ordinary brand. I had high hopes but it completely was a waste of money, I found it done nothing for my skin. The bottle is half filled and the smell is terrible, it smells like PVC. I purely just used it all to get my moneys worth. I wish I would have listened to the bad reviews so that I could've save my money. A big disappointment as I use other ordinary products that have done wonders for my skin.

Needed something hydrating and gentle for my very dry/oily skin. This does not foam so it doesn't dry my skin out or leave it feeling tight. I love that I can apply it on my dry face and rub it in and add just the tiniest bit of water and it emulsifies into milk and rinses off way faster than other cleansers. Third time buyer!

I have rosacea and this is the only cleanser that hydrates my skin. I'm 30 and have tried a lot of gentle sensitive skin cleansers, that are still too harsh. It does a good job of removing makeup, but I also double cleanse with Neutrogena fragrance free sesame oil first. (Dr dray youtube recommendation)
this is my fav cleanser. please don't discontinue the production

Love this cleanser so much! My 64 year old skin feels pampered. In my younger days, I might not have cared for it, but it's the only cleanser I use now. Last time got the 240 ml but when reordering the biggest container was a 150ml. I use this morning and night so if the 240 ml comes back, I'd definitely order it. I don't wear a lot of makeup and still have to use eye makeup remover when using this, so don't expect it to get off thick makeup. If you're a minimalist makeup gal, this product is very skin friendly. Love it!

This takes everything off! It doesn't leave my skin feeling dried out. I don't wet my face, just massage it in, then rinse. I'm on my 3rd order from The Ordinary now. Quality at a great price. Thanks for helping my skin issues!
Unfortunately for my mature normal to dry skin, this did not work.
It works well for makeup removal but does not leave the face feeling clean per say. My biggest issue is the scent, which needs improvement. It smells like cleaning my face with whiskey.
I came across this by accident thought id give it ago and i love it makes my skin feel so soft think this is my new favourite product from The ordinary well done guy's ❤️

Tried the small 50 ml and i love it i have sensitive skin so have to be very careful what i use but this feels amazing on my skin the only negative it that i can't order the biggest had to settle for 150 ml because other is out of stock we need more stock because it seems to be a very popular

I use this as my only cleanser in the morning and as my first cleanser in the evening with the glycoside cleanser as the second cleanser. Its so hydrating my irritated skin from tretinoin is starting to heal and no peel so much and I think this cleanser is the reason!

love the texture and the great result, but for a working individual when time is of essence, this takes much too long to warm up. Had been using Hylamide for years which was great, but it no longer available.

avis.titre: Love the product, but it's never in stock
avis.texte: I've been waiting months for the 240ml to come back in stock. I'm convinced they've just stopped making it. Please just take it off the site if you're not going to sell it!
Love how well this removes my eye makeup and lwsves my face feeling moisturized
If you have very oily skin it may cause you to breakout. After a few weeks of using it I had major breakouts on my jawline and hairline!

avis.titre: Excellent cleanser for stupidly sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I'm 32 and in that awful crossover time where I both have the beginnings of fine lines but my skin will also break out if the wrong thing touches it. Finding a good cleanser has been so hard - my skin is sensitive to many products, including those that get recommended frequently (CeraVe gentle cleanser broke me out, for ex). This was perfect. Gets my skin clean without drying it out or irritating it. Leaves my skin glowy, bouncy, and calm. I'm so happy. This is the first product in a long time that has made me want to hoard multiple tubes in case something happens and I can't buy it anymore.

avis.titre: I never run out of stock
avis.texte: My skin has never been clearer. I've been using this for a little over a year, and I've never been happier with my skin.

I've recently started using this cleanser again, and can't think why I ever stopped using it! My skin feels so soft and hydrated, without the feeling of any residue left behind like some balm-to-oil cleansers. It's great at removing make-up, and doesn't sting when used around the eyes either. Definitely a firm favourite.

avis.titre: Holy Grail for Dry, Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I love this stuff so much. I have a hard time finding cleansers that dont make my skin feel tight and dry and that also dont cause redness and irritation. The packaging is great makes it easy to squeeze out the perfect amount. The clesnser also does nicely at cleaning out my pores and dissolving my daily SPF. All around, jts a great gentle daily cleanser (especially if you have dry, sensitive skin).

avis.titre: Brand new almost empty squeeze tube.
avis.texte: My first purchase. The tube was less than 1/3 full. Very little product inside. What a rip off! Not happy.

I have been using this product for about 2-3 months now and absolutely love it as a pre cleanse/makeup remover.! I use waterproof makeup and find it difficult to find cleansers that are gentle AND effective. And well this is both. I warm it in my hands and apply it on my face letting it sit for a few seconds before rubbing it in. It's gentle enough that I can really work it into my eyelashes with my finger tips, after that I just I wipe it away with a damp makeup eraser and everything is gone!

I'm used to cleansers that make suds, but I also enjoy using emulsion-type products, so the quiz suggested this cleanser to me, and I bought it. I'm on the fence about it. It's not your average bubbly/sudsy cleanser. This is why I typically use it with another cleanser. I do appreciate that it doesn't dry out my face which has to be from the emulsion'ish properties. I'm on the fence about it.
It was 75% air and 25% product. There are way better make up removal cleanser out there that have more product and cost the same or less.
Imagine washing your face with lotion. Weird right? Even weirder that after you're done, skin actually feels clean. Clean and supple but not stripped.
Love this cleaner and have repurchased this several times. Feels good on my mature skin, removes all of my makeup, and the price point is great!!
I have dry skin and I found the ordinary product working well for my skin. I definitely recommend to try my skin is like a baby's bum

i have combination skin.i used the cleanser this Winter and loved it. i use it directly on my face (not as said in the palms of the hands) and gently massage it to melt it on the warm skin. that works so good. and by this way i get more out of the product. i find it removes everything and i dont need to doublecleanse....!

I have Keratosis Pilaris and had a hard time clearing my skin after make-up. Even after micellar water and other cleanser, the hard sebum was hard to remove without rubbing it hard. Squalane cleanser moisturizes my dry skin and rubricates until the makeup, dirt, and oil mix come out easily. I only bought this product by reading some recommendations, but I was surprised by what it can do to me. All I needed to do was massage my face with the dime-sized product and rinse my face.

This was part of my 1st order with The Ordinary, and I relied on the website to guide me. Although I have dry skin, I couldn't get this off, and it's listed as a cleanser. I had to use a "soap based" (foaming) cleanser to get this grease off my face. Maybe it's good for removing makeup, but I simply wanted "Step 1" of a daily regimen. I wouldn't buy this again, as it left a layer of grease on my face that didn't wipe off easily.

avis.titre: I purchased this product a couple of months ago
avis.texte: I love how this product it makes my face feel very soft and clean and it doesn't dry my skin out. I recommend this product for people that have dry skin
This cleanser did not dry my skin at all as most cleaners usually do. It leaves my skin feeling really moisturized, supple and radiant. Will definitely buy again
Maybe I just prefer a cleanser with a little more foaming, so not crazy about the lack of bubbles.
I love how you don't use water to apply this to your face. I guess it's a lazy way, but it's so awesome. Totally melts makeup away and your face comes out clean, for real.
Totally love this product. Not heavy on your skin, goes on evenly

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: It cleaned my skin pretty good. I wish there was more product in the bottle.

Made my skin feel dirty after using it. I know it's an oil cleanser, but my face feels more oily than ever. It makes my face dirty and red and my eyes keep watering and it has a burning sensation on my face My eyes cannot stop watering. Do not recommend. It didn't take all my mascara off my eye lashes. I had to use different cleansers to get my mascara off.

Not sure what the deal is here, but my face doesn't feel clean afterward, just.. gunky? The texture of my face feet's very rough and gritty as well where normally it does not. Just a very strange product. Haven't used for makeup removal.
After using it my face doesn't feel clean. Also using it on dry skin as directed seems too rough for my sensitive skin.

I have used the squalene cleanser for over a year now and just recently noticed a very unappealing smell from my current tube. I bought severalty stock up and give as gifts and this one is just nasty with a rancid scent to it. Throwing it out and opening a new one but wondering about the shelf life of the large tubes and hoping I don't have to throw them all out. May have to switch to something else in the future.
The product is really nice of you have skin that needs hydrating but the tub came half empty

This was one of the very first products I bought a few years ago. And it was a nightmare to get off and would make my skin greasy now. It is absolutely an amazing makeup remover and sunscreen remover. But with this after I used it I would have to use a regular another cleanser to remove this cleanser. Gave it three stars because it does do something good and it did leave my face soft but to use this and then go out would be a no-no. Perfect for night though

This is my first time using squalane. + Interesting aroma when washing (like sweet). +The skin after it is incredibly moisturized! + Removes waterproof mascara. -It takes a very long time to wash it off your face!
Love this cleanser. it hydrating, easily removes makeup, washes off clean.
This is the only cleanser that doesnt make me break out. I have a dry to oily skin.

I used it for two days and today was the second day of me using it I got out of the shower after cleansing my face with the cleanser and I do my skincare and I wiped my eyes and all my lashes fall out!
Totally useless, doesn't clean anything and not suitable for acne prone or slightly oily skin.

I Love this cleanser!!!! I've purchased it about 4 times already and looking to purchase my 5th! Which by the way I've just noticed they have an even larger size than I usually buy!!! Cannot wait!!! I double cleanse and this is the first step of my cleansing routine, I follow up with the Ordinary Glucoside foaming cleanser and actually look forward to it. My skin loves it and cannot do without it!!! I personally LOVE how it feels when I apply it to my skin.. the oil just feels so nice, not greasy and gross.. just the right amount of smooth.🥰 I like to leave it on my face for a few minutes before rinsing sometimes... Not sure that does anything but I just like doing it. I will Always buy this product!! Please don't change ANYTHING about it!!!! 🙌🏾🫶🏾🙌🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾

avis.titre: It works, just not my ideal cleanser
avis.texte: Ive nearly panned this product. While I wont be seeking it out, I would happily use this again in a pinch. I have very reactive combo skin and I needed something that wasn't super stripping, but properly cleansed everything. The reason I don't prefer this cleanser is because, while I acknowledge I dont need to achieve a lather to get a clean face, for me personally, even having a little lathering helps everything feel very clean. I would use this product for oil pulling/double cleansing. This product is perfectly functional and effective for its price point. I'd recommend it for anyone looking for a cheap, effective, makeup-removing oil cleanser, or even younger people looking to explore skincare more and establish a routine.
I just got my products and have begun usage. Can't wait to see the results
